title: Distinguished presentations of reduced affinoids over an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $K$ be an algebraically closed complete nonarchimedean field with nontrivial rank-one absolute value, and put $V=\{a\in K:|a|\leq1\}$, its valuation ring [def-trf-valuation-ring]. A Tate algebra $K\langle U_1,\ldots,U_s\rangle$ consists of power series whose coefficients tend to zero, with the Gauss norm; $V\langle U_1,\ldots,U_s\rangle$ is its subring of series with coefficients in $V$. Let $C\ne0$ be a reduced quotient of a Tate algebra, endowed with its affinoid Banach topology. Define $C^\circ=\{c\in C:\{c^m:m\geq0\}\text{ is bounded}\}$. There exist an integer $s\geq0$ and a continuous surjective $K$-algebra homomorphism $q:K\langle U_1,\ldots,U_s\rangle\to C$ whose restriction maps $V\langle U_1,\ldots,U_s\rangle$ onto $C^\circ$.

source.place: Theorem 6.4.3/1 (distinguished presentations), with 6.4.3/6; confirmed by Rodriguez Vazquez, Non-Archimedean normal families, section 2.2, printed p. 1685 (the paragraph preceding Proposition 2.2 and its norm-preserving lifts). Both archival PDFs WANTED.
